title: fix(core): bound retry attempts in the sync client
body: Models this repo's own PR shape: one core Rust change with an inline test module, a README touch, and a lockfile bump. Labels: the core file is RELEVANT (inline tests do not make an implementation file a test file); docs and lockfile are NOT_RELEVANT.

files.diff:
@@ -20,2 +20,3 @@
 # sync-client
+Retries are bounded (MAX_ATTEMPTS) as of this release.
